# Recorded offending after adjusting for age, sex and socioeconomic status (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Using individual-level administrative data we compare registered offending across groups
before and after adjustment. Unadjusted, the difference is substantial. After controlling
for age structure, sex ratio, socioeconomic status and urbanisation, the difference
shrinks substantially, and for several groups and offence types it largely disappears
within the confidence interval. Reporting behaviour explains part of the residual. We
report estimates with uncertainty for each offence category separately rather than a
single number.
